subject.title: fix(agents): guard stuck-session recovery with run-handle identity

question: Should captured run-handle control remain an internal embedded-run recovery detail, or should OpenClaw intentionally expose it through the plugin-SDK agent-harness APIs?
rationale: The branch’s baseline update proves the new optional parameters alter a public plugin-SDK contract, while the stated watchdog fix can capture the handle internally; choosing a lasting external API requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Refactor the recovery guard behind an internal helper or internal parameter path so the plugin-SDK surface remains unchanged.

options.title: Approve the SDK addition
options.body: Accept the new optional handle parameters as supported plugin-SDK behavior and document the intended ownership and compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Keep it internal
recommendation.body: Refactor the recovery guard behind an internal helper or internal parameter path so the plugin-SDK surface remains unchanged.
